rows.grounds: genitive singular masculine of compound antaraṅga-pradhāna

items.question: How is the self's inner-main knowable-mountain-ness described?
items.inference: The verse identifies the self's principal inner aspect as knowable-mountain-ness.
uncertainties: Morphological case of saṃvedyaparvatvam is uncertain.
Compound segmentation of antaraṅgapradhānasya is uncertain.
items.plain_english: But thus is the knowable-mountain-ness of the self whose inner aspect is principal.
